title: Context compaction runtime event payload (v0.2 template summary)
description: P0-D S3 (2026-08-14, ADR-0010 v1.10 / CONTEXT_COMPACTION_DESIGN §4): the five-section template summary replaces the A6 whole-round drop as the primary compaction mechanism. All v0.1 counters stay; the v0.2 fields describe the summary trigger (rhythm 160K / fallback 200K), the archive pointer (id/digest/path), completeness (summary_incomplete termination state) and the retained recent tail.

trigger_tokens.description: Measured prompt tokens of the previous (collapsed) model round — the value that crossed the trigger.

target_tokens.description: Kept-conversation estimate after the summary (marker + preamble + recent tail).

rounds_since_last_compaction.description: Model rounds since the previous summary (the ≥3-round cooldown, measured before this summary).

rounds_dropped.description: Complete tool rounds removed by the summary (each round = one assistant declaration plus its tool replies and injected pushes).

messages_kept.description: Messages remaining after the summary plus the injected marker.

estimated_tokens_after.description: Estimated kept-conversation tokens (chars/2 — conservative CJK-aware estimate).

summary_id.description: Archive id under .gsa/compaction/ (null when the summary failed and no archive was written).

summary_digest.description: sha256 of the archive markdown (null when no archive was written).

summary_path.description: Archive file path (null when no archive was written).

summary_incomplete.description: Termination state — the LLM slots failed validation after ≤3 attempts; only mechanical slots were kept and the marker carries the flag.

retained_rounds.description: Recent tail rounds kept verbatim after the summary (2 normally; widened by 1 on the termination state).
